Name: T's Core
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]About T's Core[/b][/size][/color]

T's Core is a shared library and framework for Stardew Valley mods.

It provides reusable systems, public APIs, Content Patcher integration, custom actions, and development tools that other mods can use to add functionality and improve compatibility.



[b][size=4][color=#00ff00]For players[/color]:[/size][/b]

T's Core is primarily a framework and does not add standalone gameplay content. In most cases, you only need to install it when another mod lists T's Core as a requirement.



T's Core supports both PC and Android and also includes optional convenience features for players. The [b]Shortcut Panel[/b] provides quick access to frequently used functions, key inputs, and mod settings directly from the game screen, with controls designed for both PC and Android. When CJB Cheats Menu is installed, the panel can also provide shortcuts to its warp destinations. The panel can be moved by dragging its handle after selecting [b]Free[/b] positioning in T's Core's GMCM settings; the default position remains fixed.



T's Core also includes optional [b]Time Skip[/b] utilities intended primarily for testing and debugging. These can advance the in-game clock to a configured time or by a configured duration, with settings available through GMCM. T's Core's GMCM text also updates when the game language is changed.



[b][size=4][color=#00ff00]For mod authors[/color]:[/size][/b]

T's Core provides reusable systems for SMAPI and Content Patcher mods. Many features can be used directly through Content Patcher without writing custom C# code, while public APIs are also available for C# mods.

Detailed setup instructions, property references, JSON examples, and API documentation are available in the GitHub Modder Guide.

[line]

[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]Documentation[/b][/size][/color]

Detailed documentation for T's Core is available on GitHub:

[u][url=https://github.com/Tikamin557/Ts-Core/tree/main/docs][/url][size=5][url=https://github.com/Tikamin557/Ts-Core/blob/main/docs/ModderGuide.md][/url][url=https://github.com/Tikamin557/Ts-Core/blob/main/README.md]GitHub Documentation[/url][/size][/u]

The documentation includes setup instructions, examples, property references, and API information for the available systems, and is actively maintained as T's Core evolves.

[line]

[color=#00ffff][b][size=6]Main Features[/size][/b][/color]

The following are some of the main systems provided by T's Core. See the GitHub Modder Guide for detailed setup instructions and usage examples.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Content Patcher Integration[/b][/size][/color]

T's Core provides additional features for Content Patcher mods, including custom T's Core Data Assets, Tile Actions, Game State Queries, Content Patcher Tokens, conditional GMCM field visibility based on installed mods, and extended Content Pack reloading for development.

Content Patcher Content Packs can register custom definitions such as Building Providers, Warp Providers, Notification Themes, Migration definitions, BigCraftable Extensions, Dialogues, Position Pickers, and Polyamory Sweet Rooms spouse room presets without writing C# code.

The

[code]tscore_cp_reload <ContentPackId>[/code]
development command can reload many Content Patcher Content Pack changes while the game is running, reducing the need to repeatedly restart Stardew Valley during development.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Warp Services[/b][/size][/color]

Provides reusable Warp Actions and Warp Providers for custom warps and dynamic destinations. Warp Providers can resolve destinations at runtime, allowing mods to avoid relying entirely on fixed map coordinates.



Warp destinations can also be defined using the

[code]TsCoreWarpPoint[/code]
tile property, allowing mods to locate warp destinations by a custom key instead of relying on fixed coordinates.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Post Renovation Patch[/b][/size][/color]

Provides a data-driven map patching system for applying map changes after FarmHouse renovations and other runtime map changes have been applied. This can be used when normal Content Patcher map edits would otherwise be overwritten by later FarmHouse changes.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Position Picker[/b][/size][/color]

Content Patcher mods can add a visual position picker to their GMCM settings through the

[code]TsCore/PositionPickers[/code]
Data Asset.



Players can select map coordinates directly in-game using a tile-snapped preview instead of entering X/Y values manually. Mods can provide a custom preview map, anchor position, instructions, and GMCM text, control the picker's placement in GMCM using BeforeField, and save the selected coordinates back to the Content Pack's existing configuration fields.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Map Properties[/b][/size][/color]

Adds custom map properties for additional location behavior, including Timed Exit functionality which can automatically warp the player out of a location at or after a specified in-game time.



Maps can also use

[code]TsCoreGreenhouse[/code]
to enable greenhouse behavior and optionally control which Back layer tile types allow fruit tree placement, and

[code]TsCoreAmbientLight[/code]
to use FarmHouse-style ambient lighting behavior. The
[code]TsCoreOutOfBoundsMask[/code]property can also cover areas outside the map boundaries with a foreground mask.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Building Services[/b][/size][/color]

Provides Building Providers and additional options for adding custom settings and visual features to buildings.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]BigCraftable Extension[/b][/size][/color]

Extends Stardew Valley BigCraftables with additional data-driven features through Content Patcher.



BigCraftables can use custom collision sizes instead of being limited to a standard 1×1 tile footprint, making it possible to create objects which occupy areas such as 1×2, 2×2, 3×3, and other custom sizes. Custom texture sizes are also supported, allowing the visual size of an object to be configured independently.



BigCraftable Extensions can also add custom interactions, placement conditions, interaction conditions, required items, item consumption, textures and animations, action animations, lights, visual effects, and wobble effects.



Placement can be restricted using Game State Queries, allowing BigCraftables to be limited to or excluded from specific types of locations.



These features can be configured through the

[code]TsCore/BigCraftableExtension[/code]
Data Asset and linked to BigCraftables through

[code]Data/BigCraftables[/code]
, without requiring custom C# code.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Dialogue System[/b][/size][/color]

Provides data-driven custom dialogues for Content Patcher mods. Dialogues can use conditions, player responses, Trigger Actions, dialogue chaining, automatic closing, and Audio Cues, and can be opened through map Tile Actions and Touch Actions.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Notification System[/b][/size][/color]

Provides customizable on-screen notifications and reusable Notification Themes. Notifications can be used from Content Patcher actions or C# mods.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Migration System[/b][/size][/color]

Provides migration support for IDs stored in existing save data, allowing mods to change supported internal IDs while preserving compatible existing save data.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Relationship & Location Services[/b][/size][/color]

Provides reusable relationship, partner, NPC romanceability, player location, and location-related information. Relationship Services also support compatible third-party relationship systems.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Polyamory Sweet Rooms Integration[/b][/size][/color]

Supported mods can provide spouse room presets for Polyamory Sweet Rooms, allowing players to configure which characters are assigned to available spouse rooms through T's Core.



Content Patcher mods which use this system can also add a button to their own GMCM settings through the

[code]TsCore/PsrRoomPresetButtons[/code]
Data Asset, allowing players to open the room assignment screen directly from the related mod's settings.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Additional Actions & Conditions[/b][/size][/color]

T's Core also provides additional Tile Actions and Game State Queries for use with Content Patcher mods, including custom sleeping behavior and location category checks. See the GitHub Modder Guide for the currently available features and usage details.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Additional Compatibility Fixes[/b][/size][/color]

T's Core also includes several internal compatibility fixes for issues which can occur with custom maps and modded game content.



These include fixes for custom FarmHouse warps (including arrival positions affected by passable Buildings-layer tiles and warp-point detection when loading saves from custom locations), Rain Totems with custom Location Contexts, Cellar entrances after FarmHouse map changes, custom tiles around spouse rooms, and day/night window behavior in custom spouse rooms.



These fixes are applied automatically where applicable and generally do not require any additional setup from players or mod authors.



[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Public APIs[/b][/size][/color]

T's Core provides documented public APIs for SMAPI C# mods so multiple mods can share common functionality instead of implementing the same systems independently. See the GitHub Modder Guide for available APIs and usage instructions.

[line]

[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]

Install T's Core using your preferred mod manager, or extract the downloaded archive into your Stardew Valley "[color=#fce5cd]Mods[/color]" folder.

T's Core requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. If another mod requires T's Core, simply install it along with the required dependencies before launching the game.
